name: The Elder Crone
summary: Seereth Stonebreak sends word from Stonetalon to Thunder Bluff. Enraged by goblin deforestation and mining, the mountain's elements need spiritual guidance, so Seereth sends emissaries to seek counsel from Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise.

sections.title: Cry from Stonetalon
sections.body: Goblin deforestation and mining have enraged the elemental spirits of Stonetalon Mountains. Seereth Stonebreak sees that force alone cannot ease the land's spiritual anguish and turns to elder shamans for wisdom. Seereth knows few tribal leaders by name, but knows of Magatha Grimtotem, an elder famed for her knowledge and commanding presence.

sections.title: Audience on Elder Rise
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem holds court atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, where shamanic and spiritual affairs gather. The Grimtotem tribe's relationship with Cairne Bloodhoof's leadership is tense and often confrontational. Even so, Magatha is a formidable elder whose counsel carries great weight across the Horde. You bring Stonetalon's troubles to her, seeking her guidance.

sections.title: A Pragmatic Alliance
sections.body: Magatha Grimtotem sends word of the elemental turmoil to the Forsaken alchemists living in the city rather than relying only on traditional tauren rites. She draws the Horde's newest and most cynical allies into Kalimdor's spiritual affairs, showing a cunning and unconventional way of handling power and problems.

faq.q: Who sends me to find Magatha?
faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak, in Stonetalon Mountains, sends you after you fight the Venture Company goblins cutting through the mountain forests.
Magatha Grimtotem lives atop Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, on the northeastern bluff linked to the central mesa by wooden bridges.

faq.q: Why is Seereth asking an elder tauren for help?
faq.answer: Goblin industry has disturbed Stonetalon's spirits. Seereth sees that force alone cannot heal the land and seeks spiritual guidance to calm the elements.

Magatha Grimtotem is the elder crone and matriarch of the Grimtotem tribe. Her tribe is fiercely aggressive and skeptical of the united Horde, while Magatha holds great political and spiritual influence atop Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What happens after speaking with Magatha?
faq.answer: Magatha hears your report on Stonetalon and sends you to Apothecary Zamah, a Forsaken emissary in the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise, for help.

faq.q: Why is this quest called 'The Elder Crone'?
faq.answer: The title refers to Magatha Grimtotem. Her own clan and the wider tauren people know her as the Elder Crone for her great age, shamanic knowledge, and authority as matriarch.

angles.text: As a tauren, you see how fragile the balance is between Cairne's united tribes and the aloof, fiercely traditional Grimtotem, who dwell in Thunder Bluff.
As a shaman, you know the weight of Stonetalon's elemental unrest. Seeking Magatha's counsel on Elder Rise reflects the spiritual crisis in Kalimdor's peaks.
You see the Horde's ties at work as Stonetalon's frontier troubles reach the high halls of Thunder Bluff's leadership.
